t.zh: <level-ref to="decl-nat"></level-ref>的声明还给出一条规则：对任何性质 P，0 有 P，并且每个 n 有 P 就推出 S n 有 P，那么每个数都有 P。写成一句话就是 ∀P. P(0) → (∀n. P(n) → P(S n)) → (∀n. P(n))。
t.en: The declaration in <level-ref to="decl-nat"></level-ref> gives one more rule: for every property P, if 0 has P and each n having P gives S n having P, then every number has P. As one sentence: ∀P. P(0) → (∀n. P(n) → P(S n)) → (∀n. P(n)).

t.zh: 它是一句已知，用的还是<part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref>和<part-ref to="part:mp"></part-ref>：选定一例时选一种性质换掉 P。
t.en: It is a given, used with <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref> and <part-ref to="part:mp"></part-ref>: choosing an instance, choose a property to put in for P.

after.zh: 这句话是自然数这个声明的消去规则。<level-ref to="in-zero"></level-ref>里两个框的归纳元件做的就是这件事：选定 P，再把两个框的结论交给它套用两次。
after.en: This sentence is the elimination rule of the declaration of the numbers. The two-box induction part of <level-ref to="in-zero"></level-ref> does just this: choose P, then hand it the two boxes’ conclusions to Apply twice.

premises.st: ∀n. plus(n, zero) = n → plus(s(n), zero) = s(n)

brief.zh: 已知归纳法、0 + 0 = 0，以及对每个 n，n + 0 = n 推出 S n + 0 = S n。证明对每个 n，n + 0 = n。
brief.en: Given induction, 0 + 0 = 0, and for every n that n + 0 = n gives S n + 0 = S n, prove n + 0 = n for every n.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref>里选性质「x + 0 = x」换掉 P。
hint.en: In <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref> choose the property “x + 0 = x” to put in for P.

hint.zh: 得到的话要两样东西才给出结论：依次套用两条已知。
hint.en: What it gives needs two things before its conclusion: Apply the two givens in turn.

brief.zh: 只用归纳法，证明每个数要么是 0，要么是某个数的 S。
brief.en: With induction alone, prove every number is 0 or S of some number.

hint.zh: 性质就是目标里对 n 说的那句：「x = 0 ∨ (∃m. x = S m)」。
hint.en: The property is what the goal says of n: “x = 0 ∨ (∃m. x = S m)”.

hint.zh: 0 的情况：自反律给 0 = 0，再引入 ∨。从 a 到 S a：S a = S a 已经是一个例子，用不着对 a 的假设。
hint.en: The case 0: reflexivity gives 0 = 0, then introduce ∨. From a to S a: S a = S a is already an example, and the assumption about a is not needed.
